Detours_2026-09-29-nmake_msvc143_x64_det.notes: The same commit as the /O2 build, compiled the way upstream documents: nmake in src/, whose Makefile hardcodes /Od /MT /Zl and has no release configuration, so this is an unoptimised build by upstream's own choice and describes a consumer who built Detours as shipped. The Makefile also builds the Itanium, ARM and ARM64 objects; the seven x86 and x64 ones are linked into a DLL here, because upstream's static detours.lib cannot be read. Measured: x86 382 functions kept of 553 (171 MSVC runtime removed), x64 332 of 508 (176), 284 and 276 of them ten instructions or more, all named. The PicHash overlap with the /O2 build, the v4.0.1 build and the MinGW build is zero at the ten-instruction floor on both architectures. Unoptimised code keeps the UCRT stdio inline wrappers (_vsnprintf, _vsnwprintf and their _l forms, and __local_stdio_printf_options on x86) that the optimiser folds away in the other builds; they are SDK code, not Detours'. The wide-stdio glue baseline removes _vsnwprintf on x64 and _vsnprintf, _vsnwprintf and __local_stdio_printf_options on x86; _vsnprintf on x64 and the _l forms on both architectures survive.

Detours_2026-09-29_mingw13_x64_detours.d.notes: Commit 1dbd4ea of microsoft/Detours, 2026-09-29, which is 133 commits past the v4.0.1 tag and carries the EVEX and REX2 copiers v4.0.1 does not. Built as seven objects linked into one DLL, since upstream's static detours.lib cannot be read: detours, modules, disasm, image, creatwth and the x86 and x64 offline copiers; the Itanium, ARM and ARM64 copiers are not linked. Measured: x86 266 functions kept of 319 (53 MinGW runtime removed), x64 272 of 326 (54 removed), 188 and 163 of them ten instructions or more. The transaction core (DetourTransactionBegin, DetourUpdateThread, DetourAttach, DetourDetach, DetourTransactionCommitEx) and CDetourDis, CDetourDisX86 and CDetourDisX64 with every Copy* member are present. The rest of the image is one-instruction kernel32 import thunks and the strsafe.h inline wrappers StringCchPrintfA/W, which are Windows SDK code rather than Detours'. v4.0.1 is not built with MinGW because its detours.h redeclares LONG_PTR, ULONG_PTR, SYMBOL_INFO and IMAGEHLP_MODULE64 whenever _MSC_VER is undefined, and the only way past that is to pretend to be MSVC. The PicHash overlap with the MSVC builds of the same commit is zero at the ten-instruction floor on both architectures. Evidence behind the family is structural only: Kaspersky names Detours and DetourTransactionCommitEx in the SharkLoader chain and publishes no matched function.
